annotations.text:
All six tabs, each drawn as an iPhone 17 Pro Max in landscape: 932x430 of display inside the bezel, clipped to the real corner radius, with the Dynamic Island on the left edge and the home indicator along the bottom. Hatched bands are the side safe areas; nothing reserves space at the bottom any more.

These are not redraws — they're the app's own markup and stylesheet, lifted straight out of a real render, so what you see is what it actually does. Drag things around on any board and save; tell me and I'll port it into the app.

The Device and Safe area sliders above each artboard adjust the corner radii and the gutter width.

About the data on these boards:

• Trainer, Overview, Kitchen and Stats draw from what's baked into the page, so they're real.
• Music shows the disconnected state — Spotify needs a live login.
• Calendar is seeded with sample events, since it reads iCloud through a Worker that isn't reachable from the build sandbox.

Each board is a static snapshot, so nothing scrolls or responds to clicks — content past the bottom edge is clipped exactly the way it would be before you scrolled.
